_schema_note: NOT a klt schema. `klt extract` is argv-only -- it has no request-document surface, unlike klt synthesize / place-and-route / sta / lvs. Filed upstream as klayout-tools#1867. flow/run_flow.py translates this document into argv; if #1867 ever lands a real `klt.extract.request/1`, this file should be replaced by one rather than kept alongside it.
_abstract_cells_note: Cell-instance granularity: every standard cell becomes a pin-only black box. Required for a digital gate-level LVS -- the reference side (klt place-and-route's as-built write_verilog netlist) instantiates cells, not transistors, so a default transistor-level extraction could never match it. See klayout-tools docs/cli/lvs.md, 'Digital gate-level LVS'.
